verdict.rationale: Flagsmith's documentation could plausibly ship an llms.txt or other agent-oriented docs, so the axis applies. A probe of https://docs.flagsmith.com/llms.txt returned HTTP 404, and no other agent-consumable docs format (markdown exports, AI-oriented doc index) is evidenced. The MCP server and CLI are separate capabilities that belong to other stories and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
